corrections.issue: Speaker attribution looks wrong: the person who says 'as a trend follow I have to just raise my hand' is the self-described trend follower Niels (who earlier described 'pure trend followers' as 'we'), not Alan Dunn, who speaks about presenting strategies to investors and reports what CTAs say.
corrections.fix: Niels Kaastrup-Larsen (probable speaker) notes that trend followers can also profit in an inflation regime from short bond positions, as in 2022.

corrections.issue: Number was silently changed: the caption reads 'a quad macro strategy with a 6.7 sharp', an obvious transcription error; the claim states 0.7 without flagging that it is an inference.
corrections.fix: Allocators now look for a Sharpe of 1 or more as a minimum regardless of correlation profile, so a respectable macro strategy (caption '6.7', probably 0.7 or 0.67) is dismissed as uninteresting, which rewards hidden tail risk.

completeness_estimate: 0.72 - first reader (64 claims) caught the main thesis chain (Fed put, pod leverage, skew/Sharpe, CTA style drift, signal design); 27 additions are mostly supporting mechanisms, numbers, Niels counterpoints and caveats, plus 2 corrections (speaker of C13-4, caption number in C03-4).
